latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of claw2claw-filetransfer.

- Enables cross-platform file transfer and sync between OpenClaw agents using rsync over SSH.
- Supports Linux, macOS, Windows (Git Bash, WSL, Cygwin).
- Provides commands for sending, getting, syncing directories, status checks, and remote file listing.
- Supports SSH key-based authentication only—no passwords required.
- Features delta transfers, compression, progress bars, and bandwidth limits.
- Includes troubleshooting tips, performance advice, and platform-specific usage notes.
